claim: Any nonadaptive family of radius-three Hamming balls that identifies every vertex of the eight-cube must contain at least 10 queries: \(M(Q_8,3)\ge10\).

integrity.computation: The included script independently recomputes all finite counts used in the proof.
integrity.proof_basis: Explicit counting and an exact integer intersection table.
integrity.unproved_limits: The exact value of M(Q_8,3) and any upper bound of 10 are not established.

scientific_limitations: Proves only M(Q_8,3) >= 10; no ten-query construction or exact value is established.
The proof is an exact signature-count and ball-intersection obstruction for nonadaptive queries of radius exactly three.
title: A Signature-Weight Obstruction for Radius-Three Ball Search on the Eight-Cube
